details:
I wrote a script, which analyzes the content of an Animator Controller for a specific problem I had (animator file grown up to 100 MB).
Out of curiosity, I have also analyzed the VRC default controllers of the SDK. I remarked, that they contains a lot of garbage, which is not used. Creators usually duplicates this controllers as base and the garbage is also in the copies (found it in the most of my own controllers).
How you can reproduce:
- Duplicate vrc_AvatarV3HandsLayer
- Delete the "Left Hand" and "Right Hand" layer - the controller should be empty now and only contain the base layer
- Create a new Animation Controller over the context menu, click it once and save (this creates an empty base layer)
- Now, open both controller files with a text editor and compare the content
- There should be a section for one AnimatorController and one AnimatorStateMachine (equals to Base Layer)
- But in the vrc_AvatarV3HandsLayer file, there are a lot of additional entries - old States, BlendTrees, Transitions and a MonoBehaviour
I would expect, that the default layers contains no garbage.
I have pushed my script to GitHub. This can analyze the controller and also remove the unused objects. Feel free to use it or not.
https://github.com/Ess-Ka/EsskaAnimatorMaintenance
title: Example VRC controllers contains garbage
